hero.title: Enterprise AI Showcase
hero.description: Twelve heavily-vetted Series A+ enterprise AI startups present live, working software directly to the roundtable executives.

opportunity.title: Six Minutes to Prove It Works
paragraphs: The Showcase is strictly for enterprise-grade AI applications with verified deployments. Foundational models are table stakes; we are interested in applied layers, orchestration, security, and measurable ROI.
Startups are integrated directly into the roundtable sessions. Each table (15 executives) will receive two 6-minute live demonstrations relevant to their specific lane.

Showcase stations are active in the central summit foyer during arrival (14:00–14:30) and the networking break (16:00–16:30). Delegates can interact directly with the software and interrogate technical principals.

criteria.title: Enterprise Grade
criteria.desc: Demonstrable SOC2/ISO compliance or pathway. Built for institutional data.

criteria.title: Live Software Only
criteria.desc: No slide decks on stage. Demos must be live, working software.

criteria.title: Verifiable ROI
criteria.desc: Clear metrics on how the application improves margins, security, or capability.
